text_block_list.text:
There was a heavy rainstorm this
morning. While
the weather's cleared
up...

The training grounds aren't in good
shape. All
training is canceled for the
day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect you to invite me on a
walk home,
Shakur. It's a little unusual of
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto, take a look at that river over
there.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, the river?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's rushing so f-fast...
With all the

rainwater, it's like a whole new river...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The river is the same. It may appear
different, but
it's just how it was
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The only thing that's changed... is the
amount of
water.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The riverbank still has plenty of
capacity, though. The rainwater might
push the river to flow a bit
faster, but it's
not going to flood out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And we know that because of some
simple math.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh... Math...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, Doto. What would happen if there
was more
water than the banks had
capacity for?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh, um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too sure about this, but it would

probably... overflow?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Change can't occur under
the
threshold, but exceed the threshold,
and change
is bound to happen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The water's gonna spill over. Doesn't
matter how
much you cry or whine about
it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but if it floods, that'd be horrible for
the
residents. Everything would get
waterlogged and
soggy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to make the riverbed bigger
before—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You can't. It's not that simple.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Making it bigger will just break the
river. And
don't think you can just scoop the
extra water
out, either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Base stats can't be easily changed, since
they're
what determine everything else.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All the rivers in the world flow atop a
set
of
numbers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just the rivers—most
phenomena
occur according to numbers
and continue with
little variation.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh... So, um... in other words...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to get it. Just know that
this year,
a lot of racers' stats are gonna
come to light.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Makes me wanna hurl, although I
should be
used to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So what's your pick? You don't have to
take my
word, but if you ignore all the
signs and take
things too far...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You'll break. That goes for you, and in
all
likelihood... your surroundings.
